definitions: A notch or a groove, especially one at the end of an arrow for fitting to the bowstring, or one on a bow for holding the string.
A small piece of material, often horn or plastic, forming the notch at the end of an arrow.
examples: He carefully fitted the arrow's nock to the bowstring.
The archer checked the nock of his arrow before shooting.
The bow had a reinforced nock for durability.
